help.goal: Fill every blank square so that each row, each column and each 3×3 box holds the digits 1 to 9 exactly once. There is only one way to do it.
steps: Tap a blank square to select it — its row, column and box light up.
Tap a number key to write that digit in.
Tap the same key again, or ⌫, to rub it out.
Tap ✏️ to switch to pencil mode, then the number keys leave small maybes in the corner.
The dark squares are the clues you were dealt — they cannot be changed.
notes: A digit that clashes with one already in its row, column or box turns red and adds one to ✖ — the mistake counter.
A red digit is not the end of anything: rub it out and carry on.
A number key fades once all nine of that digit are on the board.
⏱ runs from the deal; it stops the moment the grid is complete.
Easy, Medium and Hard differ only in how many clues you start with — every board has exactly one solution.
